PEOPLE.name: The People
PEOPLE.status: Sovereign - source of all constitutional authority

powers.text: We the People... do ordain and establish this Constitution
the right of the people peaceably to assemble
to petition the Government for a redress of grievances
the right of the people to keep and bear Arms
The right of the people to be secure... against unreasonable searches and seizures
rights... retained by the people
powers... reserved to the States respectively, or to the people

checks: All positions through elections, amendments, conventions

powers.text: All legislative Powers herein granted shall be vested in a Congress
powers.notes: Cannot be delegated; abdication occurs through delegation

powers.text: To lay and collect Taxes, Duties, Imposts and Excises
To borrow Money on the credit of the United States
To regulate Commerce with foreign Nations, and among the several States
To establish an uniform Rule of Naturalization
To coin Money, regulate the Value thereof
To provide for the Punishment of counterfeiting
To establish Post Offices and post Roads
To promote the Progress of Science and useful Arts
To constitute Tribunals inferior to the supreme Court
To define and punish Piracies and Felonies committed on the high Seas
To declare War, grant Letters of Marque and Reprisal
To raise and support Armies

To provide for calling forth the Militia
To provide for organizing, arming, and disciplining, the Militia
To exercise exclusive Legislation... over such District

prohibitions.text: The Privilege of the Writ of Habeas Corpus shall not be suspended
No Bill of Attainder or ex post facto Law shall be passed
No Capitation, or other direct, Tax shall be laid, unless in Proportion to the Census
No Tax or Duty shall be laid on Articles exported from any State
No Preference shall be given by any Regulation of Commerce
No Money shall be drawn from the Treasury, but in Consequence of Appropriations made by Law
No Title of Nobility shall be granted

powers.text: The executive Power shall be vested in a President
Commander in Chief of the Army and Navy... and of the Militia of the several States, when called into the actual Service of the United States
he shall have Power to grant Reprieves and Pardons for Offences against the United States, except in Cases of Impeachment
powers.notes: CRITICAL: This power belongs ONLY to President. Prosecutors cannot exercise pardon-equivalent immunity authority.

powers.text: He shall have Power, by and with the Advice and Consent of the Senate, to make Treaties

shall nominate, and by and with the Advice and Consent of the Senate, shall appoint Ambassadors, other public Ministers and Consuls, Judges of the supreme Court, and all other Officers of the United States
shall have Power to fill up all Vacancies that may happen during the Recess of the Senate
If he approve he shall sign it, but if not he shall return it, with his Objections
he may, on extraordinary Occasions, convene both Houses, or either of them
in Case of Disagreement between them, with Respect to the Time of Adjournment, he may adjourn them
he shall receive Ambassadors and other public Ministers
shall Commission all the Officers of the United States

duties.text: He shall from time to time give to the Congress Information of the State of the Union
recommend to their Consideration such Measures as he shall judge necessary and expedient
he shall take Care that the Laws be faithfully executed
duties.notes: CRITICAL: This is a DUTY, not a power source. Cannot be used to claim non-existent powers.

madisonian_test.name: Madisonian Six-Step Compliance Test
madisonian_test.purpose: Audit any claimed governmental action for constitutional validity

steps.name: Textual Existence
steps.question: Does the claimed power appear in constitutional text?

steps.name: Classification
steps.question: Is the action legislative, executive, or judicial?

steps.name: Logical Derivation
steps.question: Is the claimed derivation logically valid?

steps.name: Textual Consistency
steps.question: Does the same interpretation work for parallel clauses?

steps.name: Structural Delegability
steps.question: Can this power structurally be delegated?

steps.name: Position Indivisibility
steps.question: Does actor satisfy ALL constitutive conditions of position?
steps.failure_result: Actor lacks authority of claimed position

authority_derivation_checker.name: Authority Derivation Checker
authority_derivation_checker.purpose: Trace any claimed power to its constitutional source

psv_identifier.name: PSV Identifier
psv_identifier.purpose: Identify what type of PSV (if any) an action constitutes

questions.question: Is Position A exercising a power assigned to Position B?
Is a position failing to exercise a mandatory power?
Is there a law/doctrine that permits this delegation?
questions.if_yes: ENABLING PSV: Identify the enabling doctrine

questions.question: Is there a doctrine blocking remedy for this violation?
questions.if_yes: SHIELDING PSV: Identify the shielding doctrine

questions.question: Is the doctrine itself a constitutional violation that enables and shields?
